# Tanuja Bodas

> Tanuja Bodas is a Senior Product Designer & Builder. She designs enterprise B2B products and design systems, then builds and ships them herself in React, TypeScript, and Next.js, with no handoff between design and code.

## Who she is

- Senior Product Designer with 5+ years of experience, and a builder who writes and ships production code
- Designs and builds equally well: research, UX, and design systems through to deployed front-end code
- Background in code (MCA) before design; MS in User Experience and Interaction Design, Thomas Jefferson University
- 3.5 years at ZingHR as the primary designer on enterprise HR modules serving 200+ clients
- Tools: Figma, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vercel, Claude Code, Cursor
- Interested in senior IC and founding designer roles, B2B SaaS, and AI-first products

## Selected work

- [MyRCloud](https://www.tanujabodas.com/work/myrcloud): A recruitment marketplace designed from scratch, replacing a Google Sheets operation with a multi-sided platform for 100+ clients and 600+ recruiting partners
- [Rewards & Recognition](https://www.tanujabodas.com/work/rewards-and-recognition): Enterprise recognition platform for teams whose contributions were going unnoticed
- [Employee Dossier](https://www.tanujabodas.com/work/employee-dossier): Redesign of ZingHR's employee record into a single, scannable page
- [UrbanPark](https://www.tanujabodas.com/work/urbanpark): A 0 to 1 C2C driveway rental marketplace, including its design system
- [The Wren Gala](https://www.tanujabodas.com/built-with-ai/wren-gala): A charity gala website designed and built solo in under a week
